兔姥姥搬家了，兔妈妈
带蹦蹦兔去参观姥姥的新居。
蹦蹦兔穿着雪白的衬衫，
乐颠颠地跟着妈妈出门了。
page_text_en:
Grandma Rabbit has moved house, so Mom Rabbit
is taking Bubu Rabbit to visit Grandma's new home.
Bubu Rabbit, wearing a snowy white shirt,
cheerfully follows Mom out the door.
summary_zh: 兔妈妈带着蹦蹦兔去参观刚搬家的兔姥姥的新居，蹦蹦兔穿着白衬衫，开心地跟着妈妈出门。

page_text_ocr_zh:
兔姥姥的新家在红松岭别墅区。
这里林深草密，桃花盛开，
绿叶掩映下，
一座越层式小高楼出现在眼前。

兔姥姥住在五楼，
由于楼层高，
楼里装了一部电梯。
page_text_en:
Grandma Rabbit's new home is in the Hong Songling villa district.
Here, the woods are deep and grassy, peach blossoms are in full bloom,
under the shade of green leaves,
a small, multi-story building appears before your eyes.

Grandma Rabbit lives on the fifth floor.
Because the building is tall,
there is an elevator installed in the building.
summary_zh: 画面描绘了兔姥姥新家所在的红松岭别墅区，环境优美，桃花盛开，一座小高楼掩映在绿树花丛中，文字说明兔姥姥住在五楼，楼里装有电梯。

page_text_ocr_zh:
蹦蹦兔从没坐过
电梯，有些害怕，就
问妈妈：“电梯会不会掉下去呀？”

“怎么会呢？”兔妈妈说，“电梯装有
安全装置，如果停电了会牢牢卡住电梯槽两
边的钢轨，不会掉下去的。”

妈妈还跟他讲了许多关于乘坐电梯的安
全常识。蹦蹦兔把妈妈的话全都记在心里。
page_text_en:
Bongbong Rabbit had never ridden an elevator before. He was a bit scared and asked his mom, "Will the elevator fall down?"

"How could it?" said Mom Rabbit. "The elevator has safety devices. If the power goes out, it will be firmly locked onto the steel tracks on both sides of the elevator shaft, so it won't fall down."

Mom also told him many safety tips about riding elevators. Bongbong Rabbit remembered everything his mom said.
summary_zh: 蹦蹦兔第一次坐电梯，感到害怕并询问妈妈电梯会不会掉下去，兔妈妈耐心解释了电梯的安全装置，并告诉他许多乘坐电梯的安全常识，蹦蹦兔认真记在心里。

page_text_ocr_zh:
兔姥姥特别喜欢蹦蹦兔，非要留他多住几天，兔妈妈只好一个人先回家了。
姥姥年纪很大了，蹦蹦兔每天都陪着她到楼下花园里散步。
page_text_en:
Grandma Rabbit especially liked Bongbong Rabbit and insisted on keeping him for a few more days, so Mom Rabbit had to go home alone.
Grandma was very old, and Bongbong Rabbit accompanied her to the garden downstairs every day.
summary_zh: 兔姥姥喜欢蹦蹦兔，让他多住几天，兔妈妈先回家。蹦蹦兔每天陪姥姥在楼下花园散步。

page_text_ocr_zh:
一天，他们坐电梯下楼时，电梯走到一半突然停电不动了。
开始，大家以为很快就会来电，可过了很长时间，电也没有来，于是电梯里的很多人有点着急了。
page_text_en:
One day, while they were taking the elevator downstairs, the elevator suddenly stopped halfway due to a power outage.
At first, everyone thought the power would come back soon, but after a long time, the electricity still hadn't returned, so many people in the elevator started to get anxious.
summary_zh: 电梯在下楼途中突然停电，卡在半路，电梯里的人们因电力迟迟未恢复而感到焦急。

page_text_ocr_zh:
汪汪狗生气地叫道：“我上学要迟到了！”
猫阿姨也着急地说：“晚了，我就赶不上飞机了！”
淘气猴说：“咱们把电梯门扒开钻出去。”
听了这话，棒棒鸡和胖胖猪居然真的开始扒门了！
page_text_en:
Wangwang Dog shouted angrily, "I'm going to be late for school!"
Cat Auntie also said anxiously, "If I'm late, I won't make it to my flight!"
Naughty Monkey said, "Let's pry open the elevator door and crawl out."
Hearing this, Bongbong Chicken and Fat Pig actually started prying at the door!
summary_zh: 电梯停电卡在半路，汪汪狗、猫阿姨和淘气猴因焦急而情绪激动，淘气猴提议扒开电梯门，棒棒鸡和胖胖猪竟真的开始动手扒门。

page_text_ocr_zh:
蹦蹦兔大声喊道：“不能
扒门！这样很危险。如果电梯
来电突然开动了，会把
人挤死的。”
“那怎么办？
您不能这样躲下去吧！”，
page_text_en:
Bongbong Rabbit shouted loudly: "Don't pry the door open! It's very dangerous. If the elevator suddenly starts moving again when power returns, it could crush someone to death."
"What should we do? You can't just hide like this, can you!"
summary_zh: 电梯停电卡在半路，汪汪狗、猫阿姨和淘气猴因焦急而情绪激动，淘气猴提议扒开电梯门，棒棒鸡和胖胖猪竟真的开始动手扒门。蹦蹦兔大声阻止，指出扒门的危险性，提醒大家电梯突然启动会挤死人。

page_text_ocr_zh:
蹦蹦兔说：“快按下标盘上的警铃，用电话与管理员联系，让他们来救大家。”
这办法还真管用！
不一会儿，管理员就来了，大楼很快恢复了通电，电梯又开始缓缓运行了。
page_text_en:
Bengbeng Rabbit said, "Quick, press the alarm bell on the panel and use the phone to contact the administrator and ask them to rescue everyone."
This method really worked!
In no time, the administrator arrived, the building quickly restored power, and the elevator began to run slowly again.
summary_zh: 蹦蹦兔在电梯停电被困时，冷静地建议大家按警铃并打电话求助，管理员很快赶到，电梯恢复运行。

汪汪狗、猫阿姨都望着

他提醒，要不然，不知道会
发生什么事呢。”
page_text_en:
Wangwang Dog and Cat Auntie both looked at
Bengbeng Rabbit and said, "We never thought little Bengbeng Rabbit knew so much! Thanks to his reminder, otherwise, who knows what might have happened!"
summary_zh: 电梯故障解除后，汪汪狗和猫阿姨称赞蹦蹦兔在危急时刻冷静机智，提醒大家不要扒门并正确求助，避免了危险。

page_text_ocr_zh:
淘气猴、棒棒鸡和胖胖猪听了都很不好意思，纷纷说：“还是蹦蹦兔对，以后我们再也不莽撞了！”
兔姥姥听了，使劲地亲了亲蹦蹦兔的胖脸蛋。
蹦蹦兔呢，脸上也乐开了花儿。
page_text_en:
Naughty Monkey, Bamboo Chicken, and Fat Pig felt very embarrassed and said, "Bouncing Bunny is right. From now on, we won't be reckless anymore!"
Grandma Rabbit, upon hearing this, gave Bouncing Bunny a big kiss on his chubby cheeks.
Bouncing Bunny, for his part, had a big smile on his face.
summary_zh: 电梯故障解除后，淘气猴、棒棒鸡和胖胖猪因之前的莽撞行为感到不好意思，并承诺不再莽撞。兔姥姥亲了蹦蹦兔，蹦蹦兔也开心地笑了。

page_text_en: ●○ The elevator moving downward suddenly stopped, and it became pitch black inside. What's going on? This worried the little animals who were about to go out in the elevator. What will they do next? Can they safely get out of the elevator?
